content_sections.heading: About CSIR-SERC
content_sections.text: CSIR-Structural Engineering Research Centre is a National Laboratory under the aegis of the Council of Scientific & Industrial Research (CSIR). The notice describes it as one of the world's premier institutes engaged in Research & Development in Structural Engineering. It is located at CSIR Road, Taramani, Chennai 600 113, and the Project Associates will work in various projects at SERC, Chennai.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for every position is 35 years as on the date of interview. The upper age limit can be relaxed by five years for SC/ST/Women/Persons with Disabilities (PWD) and by 3 years for OBC. Prescribed qualifications must come from recognized Universities/institutions. Candidates must meet the essential qualifications and other conditions as on the date of interview. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA is paid on top of the monthly emoluments for every position. All positions are purely temporary, on a contract/temporary basis, and co-terminus with the completion of the project. The tenure of each position runs up to March 2027 and is extendable up to the date shown in the vacancy table. The tenure may be curtailed or extended. It ends with the project, or when the requirement for Project Associate-I & II ends, whichever is earlier. Under CSIR letter No. 5-1(342)/2017-PD dated 02.09.2024, the total engagement of a Project Staff in different projects of CSIR Labs/Instts. cannot exceed 6 years. Candidates who have already completed 6 years as Project Staff in any CSIR Lab/Instt. are not eligible to attend the walk-in interview. For selected candidates who have served less than 6 years, the tenure will end automatically on completion of six years. The positions do not give any right to a permanent appointment in CSIR-SERC.

content_sections.text: Open the Online Recruitment Portal link on the CSIR-SERC website www.serc.res.in . Registration opens on 16 November 2026 at 10.00 am. Fill the online application/registration form for the position you are applying for. Upload the relevant documents: certificates of educational qualifications, experience, DOB, category etc. Complete the registration by 25 November 2026, up to 05.00 pm. There is no registration fee. Do not send a hard copy of the application to the office. Report for the walk-in interview on 26 November 2026 at CSIR-SERC, Taramani, Chennai - 600113. The interview time is 09.00 AM, and no candidate will be allowed into the venue after 10.30 AM. Only registered candidates will be allowed to attend the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates attending the interview should bring: The duly signed online application form Self-attested photocopies of all the requisite certificates Aadhaar card Mark sheets in support of age and educational qualifications GATE Score card and experience certificates (if applicable) Original certificates, for verification on the date of interview and, if selected, at the time of joining Candidates who do not bring their application form with the requisite educational/experience certificates, mark sheets etc. will not be allowed to attend the interview. Any document in a language other than Hindi or English must come with an English transcript attested by a Gazetted officer or Notary.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-SERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice lists 16 positions: 7 Project Associate-II and 9 Project Associate-I. The number is indicative and may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to register for CSIR-SERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online registration runs from 16 November 2026 (10.00 am) to 25 November 2026 (up to 05.00 pm). The walk-in interview is on 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Can I attend the CSIR-SERC walk-in interview without registering online?
faq.answer: No. Only candidates who registered online will be allowed to attend the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for CSIR-SERC Project Associate posts?
faq.answer: Each position needs a B.E/B.Tech in the discipline named for it from a recognized University/Institute. Most Project Associate-II positions also need 2 years of R&D experience. The SSP 479 Project Associate-II position accepts 2 years of working experience with a Civil B.E/B.Tech, or an M.E/M.Tech/M.S. in Structural Engineering or other related fields.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSIR-SERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the date of interview. It is relaxable by five years for SC/ST/Women/PWD candidates and by 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a CSIR-SERC Project Associate?
faq.answer: Project Associate-II gets ₹35,000 p.m. + HRA if NET/GATE/National level exam qualified, otherwise ₹28,000 p.m. + HRA. Project Associate-I gets ₹31,000 p.m. + HRA or ₹25,000 p.m. + HRA on the same basis.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is added to the monthly emoluments for every Project Associate-I and Project Associate-II position.

faq.question: Q8. Is there an application fee for CSIR-SERC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that there is no registration fee.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview on 26 November 2026. If there are many applicants, CSIR-SERC may first shortlist by qualification, experience, marks, a written test or another method of the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent jobs?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the projects, with tenure up to March 2027 that may be extended. Total CSIR project service cannot exceed 6 years.
